decisions.verifier: verify_implementation_landed_intake_runtime.py is the runtime helper of the integration test. It only runs gh read commands and writes a local artifact; the tests drive it with a fake runner. It is never executed against live GitHub here. Its ISSUE_NUMBER / PR_NUMBER constants still carry legacy-repository numbers (2119 / 2137); they must be replaced before any live run (I-4-4D).
decisions.deferral: Two source tests still cannot run in this repository: one reads impl-review-loop/SKILL.md (owner I-4-4D) and one is a live GitHub canary. They are listed in deferred_tests (explicitly deselected by the CI runner, never skipped or weakened). No placeholder document was added to make them pass. The other five deferred tests were restored by I-4-4D1 (#89) when steps/preparation.md and steps/step-1-implementation.md were migrated; see restored_by_d1 and historical_pre_d1.
